title: Cheese came out thin and curly! Not as well made as it use to be!
text:
Cheese came out thin and curly! Not as well made as it use to be!. I have a big box grater, and this grater is easier to use if your not
grating allot at one time.
The handle is comfortable, and the other end has a rubber piece to
Keep the grater from moving around.

I grated Munster cheese with this, and it came out curly , and in very thin
Pieces!
I have never seen using other graters that the cheese looked like this!

Comes with a thin plastic cover. The grater looks ok, but it’s cheaply made.
I remember when Farberware was made in the USA , now it doesn’t meet the
standard of other kitchen utensils or cookware, and I doubt if this will
Last as long as my older Farberware, or other graters!
I would not put this in the dishwasher.
I wash this with a kitchen brush with soap, the brush gets into the odd places,
And cleans it good.

Includes a blade cover for protection when not in use. Measures 12-1/2 inches long. Dishwasher safe.
